items.headline: Global Oil Prices Surge Near $110 Amid Middle East Shipping Disruptions
items.summary: Global crude oil prices spiked toward $110 per barrel following attacks on Middle East energy infrastructure and rising shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz. The sudden jump in energy costs is raising concerns about persistent global inflation and complicating upcoming central bank interest rate decisions.

items.headline: China Proposes New Export Controls on Artificial Intelligence Technologies
items.summary: China's government has proposed new export controls covering 40 advanced technologies, including 23 artificial intelligence fields such as large language models and autonomous agents. Citing national security concerns, officials introduced immediate pre-export registration requirements while seeking public feedback on performance-based restrictions.

items.headline: 2026 UCI Track World Championships Conclude in Shanghai as Harrie Lavreysen Claims 23rd Title
items.summary: The 2026 UCI Track World Championships concluded in Shanghai on October 18, with Dutch sprinter Harrie Lavreysen securing his 23rd career world title by winning his eighth consecutive individual sprint. Great Britain finished at the top of the championship medal table after earning six gold medals across the five days of international competition.

items.headline: A24's Elizabeth Holmes Documentary 'You Can See Everything' Delivers Historic $15 Million Debut
items.summary: Directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' grossed an estimated $15 million across 855 North American theaters during its opening weekend. The film achieved the biggest domestic debut for a non-music documentary in over twenty years, propelled by more than 2,000 sold-out screenings.
